title: Variants in NR6A1 cause a novel oculo-vertebral-renal (OVR) syndrome
authors: Neelathi UM; Ullah E; George A; Maftei MI; Elangovan E; Sanchez-Mendoza D; Adams C; McGaughey D; Sergeev YV; AI Rawi R; Naik A; Bender C; Maumenee IH; Michaelides M; Tan TG; Lin S; Villasmil R; Blain D; Hufnagel RB; Arno G; Young RM; Guan B; Brooks BP
one_liner_zh: 该文通过基因组测序和斑马鱼实验鉴定NR6A1基因变异导致眼-椎-肾综合征，属于临床遗传学与发育表型研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Colobomatous microphthalmia is a potentially blinding congenital ocular malformation that can present either in isolation or together with other syndromic features. Despite a strong genetic component to disease, many cases lack a molecular diagnosis. We describe a novel autosomal dominant oculo-vertebral-renal (OVR) syndrome in six independent families characterized by colobomatous microphthalmia, missing vertebrae and congenital kidney abnormalities. Genome sequencing identified six rare variants in the orphan nuclear receptor gene NR6A1 in these families. We performed in silico, cellular and zebrafish experiments to demonstrate the NR6A1 variants were pathogenic or likely pathogenic for OVR syndrome. Knockdown of either or both zebrafish paralogs of NR6A1 results in abnormal eye and somite development, which was rescued by wild-type but not variant NR6A1 mRNA. Illustrating the power of genomic ascertainment in medicine, our study establishes NR6A1 as a critical factor in eye and vertebral development and a pleiotropic gene responsible for OVR syndrome.
abstract_zh: 缺损性小眼球症是一种可能导致失明的先天性眼部畸形，可单独出现或与其他综合征特征并存。尽管该疾病具有强烈的遗传成分，但许多病例缺乏分子诊断。我们在六个独立家系中描述了一种新型常染色体显性眼-椎-肾（OVR）综合征，其特征为缺损性小眼球症、椎骨缺失和先天性肾脏异常。基因组测序在这些家系中鉴定出孤儿核受体基因NR6A1的六个罕见变异。我们进行了计算机模拟、细胞和斑马鱼实验，证明NR6A1变异对OVR综合征具有致病性或可能致病性。敲低斑马鱼中NR6A1的一个或两个旁系同源基因会导致眼睛和体节发育异常，而野生型而非变异型NR6A1 mRNA可挽救这一表型。我们的研究展示了基因组检测在医学中的力量，确立了NR6A1作为眼睛和椎骨发育的关键因子，以及导致OVR综合征的多效性基因。
